description: The plot illustrates how loss changes over training iterations for three SepLLM runs and a fixed baseline reference. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 95,000 to 125,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 5,000 iterations. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.0 to 3.0 with tick labels at 2.0, 2.4, 2.6, 2.8, and 3.0. A solid pink line (SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)) starts near the top of the axis around 3.0 at ~95k iterations, drops steeply by ~100k to roughly the mid–2.4 range, and then continues a gradual decline to about 2.22–2.24 by ~125k. A solid blue line (SepLLM (n=128)) begins near ~3.0 around 95k, decreases to roughly ~2.55–2.60 by ~100k, and then declines more slowly to around ~2.28–2.30 by ~125k. A solid orange line (SepLLM (n=64)) follows a similar downward trajectory, starting near ~3.0 around 95k, reaching roughly ~2.58–2.62 by ~100k, and ending near ~2.30–2.32 by ~125k; it also shows a narrow upward spike around ~101k iterations reaching close to ~2.8 before returning to the surrounding trend. A red dashed horizontal line (Vanilla before post-training) is constant across the x-range at approximately 2.35.
